title: Wick Liquor Carnival 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Wick Liquor Carnival is a decadent treat for dessert lovers. It evokes the taste of a Santa Monica fairground, blending warm, sweet glazed dough rings with the rich, vanilla-infused notes of Cholo sugar skull cake. This complex bakery profile is sweet, comforting, and layered with sugary goodness. Manufactured in Staffordshire, Wick Liquor is a premium boutique brand famous for its "big block" approach to flavour, offering some of the most distinct and high-quality blends on the market. This Nic Salt version offers the same legendary taste in a smooth format. With a 50% VG / 50% PG blend, this e-liquid is perfectly balanced for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping. It is designed to pair flawlessly with low-wattage pod kits and starter vape kits, producing discreet vapour and exceptional flavour clarity. The nicotine salt formulation ensures a smooth throat hit and rapid satisfaction. Wick Liquor Nic Salts are available in 10mg and 20mg strengths. This 10ml e-liquid is TPD-compliant and features a childproof cap and tamper-evident seal.
